# Florida Tech Research

> Florida Institute of Technology's comprehensive research hub featuring 15+ specialized labs and centers across aerospace, biomedical, materials science, and environmental disciplines.

Research.fit.edu serves as the central directory for Florida Tech's research infrastructure, showcasing faculty-led laboratories and interdisciplinary centers. The site aggregates research initiatives spanning autonomous systems, advanced manufacturing, tissue engineering, coastal science, and computational technologies.

## Key Topics

- Autonomous Systems
- Biomedical Engineering
- Materials Science
- Computational Fluid Dynamics
- Tissue Engineering
- Environmental Research
- Aerospace Technology
- Advanced Manufacturing
- Marine Systems
- Medical Imaging
- Thermal Energy Systems
- Coastal Resilience
- Safety-Critical Systems
- Biomaterials

## Aerospace & Autonomy Labs

- [Autonomy Lab](https://research.fit.edu/autonomy-lab): Aerospace autonomy, spacecraft control, and adaptive systems research
- [ATLAS Lab](https://research.fit.edu/atlas): Human factors and autonomy in aviation systems research
- [Adv. Computational Fluid Dynamics & Turbulence Lab](https://research.fit.edu/adv-computational-fluid-dynamics--turbulence-lab): CFD, turbulence modeling, and high-performance computing research

## Biomedical & Tissue Engineering

- [Bashur Lab - Vascular Tissue Engineering](https://research.fit.edu/bashur): Vascular tissue engineering and biomaterials research
- [Biomanufacturing](https://research.fit.edu/biomanufacturing): 3D bioprinting vascularized tissues for space applications
- [BiCLab](https://research.fit.edu/biclab): Medical imaging, deep learning, and biocomputing research
- [Biomedical Instrumentation & Ultrasound Research](https://research.fit.edu/kaya): Ultrasound imaging, cardiovascular monitoring, and biosensors research
- [Bio-Mechanics Laboratory](https://research.fit.edu/bio-mechanics-laboratory): Soft materials mechanics and computational modeling

## Materials & Manufacturing

- [Adv. Manufacturing & Material Characterization Lab](https://research.fit.edu/adv-manufacturing-material-characterization-lab): Shape memory alloys and advanced materials for aerospace and biomedical applications
- [Center for Advanced Coatings](https://research.fit.edu/coatings): Thermal barrier coatings research for turbine and aerospace systems
- [Adsorption and Energy Technology Laboratory](https://research.fit.edu/pahinkar): Adsorption-based thermal energy systems research

## Environmental & Marine Science

- [Center for Resilience Science](https://research.fit.edu/center-for-resilience-science): Climate adaptation and coastal resilience research
- [Coastal Processes Research Group](https://research.fit.edu/wave-data): Oceanographic monitoring and wave data collection at Sebastian Inlet
- [Center for Corrosion and Biofouling Control](https://research.fit.edu/ccbc): Corrosion and biofouling control research for marine systems
- [CARE](https://research.fit.edu/care): Aquarium research consortium for Indian River Lagoon conservation
- [Center for Applied Biogeography](https://research.fit.edu/applied-biogeography): Pollen database and neotropical plant research

## Safety & Systems Research

- [ASSIST Lab](https://research.fit.edu/assist-lab): Assurance frameworks for safety-critical systems research

## Animal & Behavioral Science

- [Animal Behavior and Cognition Research](https://research.fit.edu/animal): Animal Cognitive Research Center: primate behavior and cognition studies

## Research Directory & Resources

- [Research Labs and Institutes](https://research.fit.edu): Central directory of Florida Tech research labs and institutes
- [Coastal Climate Adaptation Library](https://research.fit.edu/ccal): Climate adaptation resources and research database
